question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The government aims not only to revitalize the stagnant manufacturing sector but also ____________.
options: allocating funds for rural development
to stimulate job creation in the hinterlands
stimulating job creation in the hinterlands
it has stimulated job creation
answer: to stimulate job creation in the hinterlands
explanation: Rule of Parallelism: 'not only... but also' wale sentences mein dono taraf same grammatical structure hona chahiye. Sentence mein 'not only' ke baad 'to revitalize' (Infinitive) aaya hai, toh 'but also' ke baad bhi 'to + V1' aayega. Options 1, 3, aur 4 galat hain kyunki unmein gerund (V+ing) ya alag tense use hua hai. Stagnant ka matlab 'ruka hua' aur hinterlands ka matlab 'gramin kshetra' hota hai.
trick: Sentence mein 'not only to + V1' dekho, aur turant 'but also to + V1' wala option eliminate karke dhundo.
tip: Correlative conjunctions hamesha strict parallel structure follow karte hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Had the monetary policy committee foreseen the sudden spike in global crude prices, ____________.
options: they will not have paused the rate hike cycle
it would not have paused the rate hike cycle
it would not pause the rate hike cycle
they would not pause the rate hike cycle
answer: it would not have paused the rate hike cycle
explanation: Conditional Type 3 & Pronoun Agreement: 'Had + Subject + V3' past ki unreal condition dikhata hai. Iske main clause mein 'would have + V3' aata hai. Saath hi, 'monetary policy committee' ek collective noun hai, isliye iske liye singular pronoun 'it' aayega, 'they' nahi. Option 2 dono rules (would have + V3 aur singular pronoun) ko follow karta hai.
trick: Pehle pronoun check karo (Committee = it), fir tense check karo (Had + V3 = would have + V3). Baaki sab eliminate ho jayenge.
tip: Past Perfect conditional mein hamesha 'would have + V3' ka use hota hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The new fiscal policy focuses on streamlining tax collection, expanding the taxpayer base, and ____________.
options: to penalize consistent defaulters
penalize the consistent defaulters
penalizing chronic tax evaders
the penalization of chronic tax evaders
answer: penalizing chronic tax evaders
explanation: Parallelism (Gerund List): Sentence mein prepositions 'on' ke baad aane wali list gerunds (V1+ing) ki hai - 'streamlining', 'expanding'. Isliye 'and' ke baad aane wala teesra element bhi gerund form (penalizing) mein hona chahiye. Chronic ka matlab 'lamba chalne wala ya aadi'.
trick: List ke pehle do words (streamlining, expanding) 'ing' form mein hain, toh teesra bhi 'ing' (penalizing) hi hoga.
tip: Comma se judi hui items hamesha same grammatical form mein hoti hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Driven by an unprecedented surge in domestic consumption and foreign direct investment, ____________.
options: the inflation rate has finally been stabilized by the central bank
the economy of the country recorded a double-digit growth
there was a significant boost in the country's GDP
it is expected that the GDP will rise significantly
answer: the economy of the country recorded a double-digit growth
explanation: Dangling Modifier Rule: Sentence ek participle phrase 'Driven by...' se shuru hota hai. Comma ke theek baad wahi noun aana chahiye jiske baare mein yeh phrase baat kar raha hai. 'Consumption aur investment' se economy drive hoti hai, inflation ya 'there/it' nahi. Isliye 'the economy' hi logically correct subject hai. Unprecedented matlab 'abhootpoorv'.
trick: Comma ke baad us subject ko dhundo jo actually 'driven by surge' ho sakta hai. Economy hi drive ho sakti hai.
tip: Participle phrase ke theek baad uska sahi logical subject aana zaroori hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The environmental regulatory board mandates that every industrial unit ____________.
options: must adopt zero-emission technologies by 2030
adopts zero-emission technologies by 2030
adopt zero-emission technologies by 2030
should adopted zero-emission technologies by 2030
answer: adopt zero-emission technologies by 2030
explanation: Subjunctive Mood: Jab sentence mein formal verbs jaise 'mandate', 'suggest', 'demand', 'insist' aate hain aur uske baad 'that' clause hota hai, toh clause ka verb hamesha base form (V1 without s/es) mein aata hai, chahe subject singular hi kyu na ho. Isliye 'every industrial unit' (singular) ke bawajood 'adopt' aayega, 'adopts' ya 'must adopt' nahi.
trick: 'Mandate that' dekhte hi samajh jao ki aage wala verb bina kisi helping verb ya 's/es' ke base form mein aayega.
tip: Formal recommendations (demand/insist/mandate that) always take base verb forms.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Scarcely had the finance minister concluded her budget speech outlining the ambitious privatization drive ____________.
options: than the stock market indices plummeted sharply
when the stock market indices plummeted sharply
then the stock market indices plummeted sharply
when the stock markets plunge sharply
answer: when the stock market indices plummeted sharply
explanation: Inversion & Conjunction Pairing: 'Scarcely' aur 'Hardly' ke baad hamesha past perfect mein inversion (had + subject) aata hai aur doosra clause 'when' ya 'before' se judta hai, 'than' ya 'then' se nahi. 'Than' hamesha 'No sooner' ke sath aata hai. Tense past hona chahiye, isliye 'plunge' (present) wala option galat hai. Plummeted ka matlab 'tezi se girna'.
trick: Hardly/Scarcely = when. No sooner = than. Tense dono taraf past hona chahiye.
tip: Scarcely aur Hardly hamesha 'when' ke sath pair hote hain, 'than' nahi.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The managing director, along with the principal shareholders and the board members, ____________.
options: are vehemently opposing the hostile takeover bid
have vehemently opposed the hostile takeover bid
is vehemently opposing the hostile takeover bid
were vehemently opposing the hostile takeover bid
answer: is vehemently opposing the hostile takeover bid
explanation: Subject-Verb Agreement: Jab do subjects 'along with', 'as well as', ya 'together with' se jude hote hain, toh verb hamesha pehle subject ke hisaab se aata hai. Yahan pehla subject 'The managing director' (singular) hai. Isliye verb 'is' aayega, na ki 'are' ya 'have'. Vehemently matlab 'zor-shor se'.
trick: Sentence mein commas (,) ke beech wale hisse ko ignore karo aur main subject 'managing director' ke liye verb dhundo.
tip: Words like 'along with' ignore karke pehle subject par focus karo.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Ever since the apex court struck down the controversial electoral bonds scheme, ____________.
options: political funding has become significantly more transparent
political funding became significantly more transparent
political funding had become significantly more transparent
political funding is becoming significantly transparent
answer: political funding has become significantly more transparent
explanation: Tense Rules for 'Since': Jab 'since' / 'ever since' point of time (past ki ghatna) dikhata hai, toh 'since' ke baad wala clause Simple Past mein hota hai (struck down), aur main clause Present Perfect mein (has become) hota hai. Iska matlab hai wo kaam past mein shuru hua aur abhi bhi sach hai.
trick: Formula yaad rakho: Ever since + Simple Past, Present Perfect. Isliye main clause mein 'has/have + V3' aayega.
tip: 'Ever since' wale structure mein main clause generally Present Perfect hota hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The recently published economic survey reveals that the developing nation has neither adequately invested in healthcare infrastructure ____________.
options: nor it has prioritized primary education
or prioritized primary education
nor prioritized primary education
nor did it prioritize primary education
answer: nor prioritized primary education
explanation: Correlative Conjunctions & Parallelism: 'Neither... nor' hamesha pair mein aate hain. Sentence mein 'neither' ke baad aane wala part adverb + past participle ('adequately invested') hai. Toh 'nor' ke baad bhi past participle aana chahiye taki parallel structure barkarar rahe. 'nor it has' ya 'nor did it' sentence ka structure tod dete hain.
trick: 'Neither' ke theek baad kya hai dekho (invested - V3). Toh 'nor' ke theek baad bhi verb ki 3rd form aani chahiye.
tip: 'Neither... nor' strict grammatical symmetry follow karte hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Although the bilateral trade agreement promises to eliminate tariffs on agricultural exports, ____________.
options: but it fails to address non-tariff barriers effectively
yet it failed to address non-tariff barriers effectively
it fails to address non-tariff barriers effectively
despite it failing to address non-tariff barriers effectively
answer: it fails to address non-tariff barriers effectively
explanation: Conjunction Redundancy: Standard English grammar mein 'Although' ya 'Though' ke baad wale main clause ko shuru karne ke liye 'but', 'despite' ya kisi aur conjunction ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Bas ek comma (,) kaafi hota hai. 'Yet' chal sakta hai purani English mein, par yahan 'failed' (past tense) tense mismatch kar raha hai. Option 3 is grammatical and tense-consistent.
trick: Agar sentence 'Although' se shuru ho, toh doosre part mein 'but' ya 'despite' bilkul nahi aayega.
tip: 'Although' wale sentence mein 'but' ka prayog grammatical error hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: To survive in the hyper-competitive global market, indigenous tech startups must be agile, innovative, and ____________.
options: possess high financial resilience
financially resilient
they must have financial resilience
possessing financial resilience
answer: financially resilient
explanation: Adjective Parallelism: Sentence mein 'be' verb ke baad adjectives ki list chal rahi hai: 'agile' (Adjective), 'innovative' (Adjective). Isliye 'and' ke baad aane wala teesra word bhi adjective phrase hi hona chahiye. 'financially resilient' ek adjective phrase hai. Indigenous matlab 'swadeshi'.
trick: Pichle do words dekho: agile aur innovative. Ye kisi ki khasiyat bata rahe hain, toh aakhri option bhi khasiyat (resilient) hi hona chahiye.
tip: List mein saare elements ki parts of speech same honi chahiye.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Unless the municipal corporation immediately overhauls the dilapidated drainage network, ____________.
options: the city will not be saved from severe waterlogging
the city will not succumb to severe waterlogging
the city will be saved from severe waterlogging
the city would not be saved from severe waterlogging
answer: the city will not be saved from severe waterlogging
explanation: Conditionals & Logical Meaning: 'Unless' ka matlab 'If not' (jab tak ki nahi) hota hai. First clause First Conditional mein hai (Simple Present). Isliye main clause Simple Future (will) mein hoga. Meaning dekhein toh: 'Jab tak network theek nahi hota, shahar doobne se nahi bachega'. 'will not be saved' logically correct hai. Succumb ka matlab 'haar maan lena' aur dilapidated ka 'toota-phoota'.
trick: Unless wale clause ka meaning nikalo: 'Agar corporation theek NAHI karti hai, toh shahar bachega NAHI'. Context check zaroori hai.
tip: Unless negative hota hai, iske result clause ka logic dhyan se padhein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: A major concern for global investors navigating the volatile emerging markets is ____________.
options: because the geopolitical tensions are escalating rapidly
that geopolitical tensions are escalating rapidly
how geopolitical tensions escalating rapidly
the rapid escalation of geopolitical tensions are unpredictable
answer: that geopolitical tensions are escalating rapidly
explanation: Noun Clause Rule: 'The reason is...' ya 'A major concern is...' ke baad reason ya concern batane ke liye hamesha 'that' se shuru hone wala noun clause aata hai. 'is because' galat structure hai kyunki 'because' ek adverb clause shuru karta hai jo subject complement nahi ban sakta. Volatile matlab 'asthi'.
trick: 'Concern is' ya 'Reason is' padhte hi aage 'that' dhoondo. 'Because' grammar ke hisaab se completely wrong hota hai wahan.
tip: 'Is' (linking verb) ke baad that-clause aata hai, because-clause nahi.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: No sooner did the regulatory authority ease the strict foreign exchange norms ____________.
options: when foreign institutional investors started pulling out funds
than foreign institutional investors flooded the domestic market
then foreign institutional investors flooded the domestic market
that foreign institutional investors flooded the domestic market
answer: than foreign institutional investors flooded the domestic market
explanation: Correlative Conjunction: 'No sooner' ek comparative degree ka phrase hai (soon-sooner). Isliye iske sath hamesha 'than' aata hai, 'when', 'then', ya 'that' nahi. Sentence mein inversion 'did + subject + V1 (ease)' ka rule pehle hi correctly apply ho chuka hai.
trick: No sooner mein 'ER' (comparative) chupa hai, aur comparative hamesha 'THAN' leta hai, T-H-A-N.
tip: 'No sooner' ka proper pair hamesha 'than' hota hai, 'then' nahi.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The committee intends to appoint a seasoned economist, one ____________.
options: who they believe can navigate the impending recession
whom they believe can navigate the impending recession
which they believe can navigate the impending recession
who can be believed to navigate the impending recession
answer: who they believe can navigate the impending recession
explanation: Relative Pronoun (Who vs Whom): Yahan ek common trap hai 'they believe'. Jab sentence mein embedded clauses (jaise they think, they believe) aate hain, unhe mind mein delete karke dekhein. Sentence bachega: '...one ___ can navigate the recession'. Kyunki aage aane wale verb (can navigate) ko ek subject chahiye, hum subject pronoun 'who' ka use karenge, object pronoun 'whom' ka nahi.
trick: Sentence mein se 'they believe' ko hide karke padho. Agar seedha verb (can navigate) bacha hai, toh 'who' lagao.
tip: Subject position par hamesha 'who' aata hai, chahe clause kitna bhi lamba ho.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The historian argued that the empire's collapse was caused by corrupt leadership, prolonged warfare, and ____________.
options: the economy was decaying
because of economic decay
economic decay
decaying of the economy
answer: economic decay
explanation: Noun Phrase Parallelism: 'by' preposition ke baad noun phrases ki list chal rahi hai: 'corrupt leadership' (Adjective + Noun), 'prolonged warfare' (Adjective + Noun). Isliye list ka aakhri hissa bhi same format mein 'economic decay' (Adjective + Noun) hona chahiye. Baaki options parallel nahi hain.
trick: Options padhne se pehle series ka format check karo. 'corrupt leadership' aur 'prolonged warfare' dono noun phrases hain, toh teesra bhi noun phrase hoga.
tip: Series of items ek hi parts of speech se bani honi chahiye.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The more aggressively the central bank tightens liquidity to control soaring commodity prices, ____________.
options: the more higher the risk of triggering an economic recession
the greater the risk of triggering an economic recession
greater is the risk of triggering an economic recession
the risk of triggering an economic recession becomes greater
answer: the greater the risk of triggering an economic recession
explanation: Double Comparatives: Jab do continuous badhne ya ghatne wali cheezon ka zikar ho, toh structure hamesha 'The + Comparative ... , The + Comparative ...' hota hai. Pehla hissa 'The more aggressively' se shuru hai, toh doosra hissa bhi 'The + Comparative' se hoga. 'more higher' double comparative error hai. 'the greater' sahi format hai.
trick: Comma se pehle 'The + er / more' dekho. Comma ke baad waisa hi option dhundo jiski shuruat 'The + er / more' se ho.
tip: Parallel comparatives: The + comparative, the + comparative format yaad rakhein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The monsoon having been remarkably deficient this agricultural season, ____________.
options: the farmers are anticipating a bumper crop harvest
rural consumption is expected to take a massive hit
the government has expected a massive hit in rural consumption
it is expecting that rural consumption will decrease
answer: rural consumption is expected to take a massive hit
explanation: Absolute Phrase & Contextual Logic: Sentence 'The monsoon having been...' (Nominative Absolute) se shuru hai jo reason bata raha hai ki baarish bahut kam hui. Deficient ka matlab 'kami'. Iska logical result negative hoga. Option 1 positive hai (bumper crop) isliye galat. Option 3 mein tense (has expected) present perfect galat hai. Passive tone 'is expected' yahan bilkul fit baithta hai editorial style mein.
trick: Baarish kam (deficient) hui hai toh kheti kharab hogi. Isliye logical negative result wala option chuno jiska tense present/future context mein ho.
tip: Editorial tone mein cause aur uske broad economic effect ka logic milaayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Having enjoyed an era of unprecedented quantitative easing, the financial markets are not accustomed ____________.
options: to operate in a high-interest-rate environment
to operating in a high-interest-rate environment
for operating in a high-interest-rate environment
with operating in a high-interest-rate environment
answer: to operating in a high-interest-rate environment
explanation: Prepositional Idiom: Kuch fixed phrases jaise 'accustomed to', 'look forward to', 'prone to', aur 'used to (adjective form)' ke baad infinitive (V1) nahi aata, balki hamesha gerund (V1+ing) aata hai. Yahan preposition 'to' ke baad noun form aani hoti hai. Quantitative easing ka matlab central bank ka economy mein paisa daalna.
trick: 'Accustomed to' ke theek baad V1 (operate) nahi balki ing-form (operating) lagao kyunki yahan 'to' ek preposition hai, infinitive marker nahi.
tip: Accustomed to, looking forward to hamesha gerund (V1+ing) lete hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Every prominent bank and non-banking financial company must ensure that ____________.
options: their compliance protocols align with international standards
its compliance protocols align with international standards
there compliance protocols align with international standards
it's compliance protocols align with international standards
answer: its compliance protocols align with international standards
explanation: Pronoun Antecedent Agreement: Jab sentence ka subject 'Each' ya 'Every' se start hota hai, bhale hi aage do nouns 'and' se kyun na jude hon (bank and company), unhe singular hi treat kiya jata hai. Isliye pronoun 'their' nahi, balki 'its' aayega. Option 4 'it's' ka matlab 'it is' hota hai jo grammar wise galat hai.
trick: Subject ki shuruaat mein 'Every' dikh jaye, toh sidha singular possessive pronoun (its/his/her) wala option final karo.
tip: 'Every' se jude subjects hamesha singular pronouns (its) use karte hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: In an effort to mitigate the impending fiscal deficit, the finance ministry must either drastically curtail non-essential subsidies ____________.
options: or it should increase the direct tax brackets
or increasing the direct tax brackets
or increase the direct tax brackets
nor increase the direct tax brackets
answer: or increase the direct tax brackets
explanation: Rule of Parallelism: 'either... or' ke dono taraf same grammatical structure hona chahiye. Yahan 'either' ke baad base verb 'curtail' (kam karna) aaya hai. Isliye 'or' ke baad bhi base verb 'increase' aayega. Options 1 aur 2 parallel structure todte hain, aur 'nor' sirf 'neither' ke sath aata hai. Mitigate ka matlab 'kam karna' aur impending ka 'aane wala'.
trick: 'Either' ke theek baad wala word dekho (curtail - V1), toh 'or' ke theek baad bhi V1 wala option hi sahi hoga.
tip: Either...or aur Neither...nor hamesha strict parallel format follow karte hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Not only has the persistent supply-chain disruption inflated the cost of raw materials, ____________.
options: but it also delayed the execution of critical infrastructure projects
but it has also delayed the execution of critical infrastructure projects
but also it delayed the execution of critical infrastructure projects
but delayed the execution of critical infrastructure projects as well
answer: but it has also delayed the execution of critical infrastructure projects
explanation: Inversion & Tense Consistency: Jab sentence 'Not only' se shuru hota hai, toh pehla clause inverted form (helping verb + subject) mein hota hai (has the disruption inflated). Par doosra clause 'but also' normal subject-verb order mein hona chahiye aur tense same (Present Perfect) hona chahiye. Option 2 mein 'has delayed' tense match kar raha hai aur 'but... also' ka sahi split placement hai. Persistent matlab 'lagatar'.
trick: Pehle hisse ka tense check karo ('has inflated' - Present Perfect). Toh doosre hisse mein bhi 'has/have + V3' aana zaroori hai.
tip: 'Not only' ke inversion mein main tense match karna mat bhoolna.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Recognizing the critical vulnerabilities in the current cyber-security framework, ____________.
options: a comprehensive data protection law was drafted by the parliamentary committee
the parliamentary committee drafted a comprehensive data protection law
drafting a comprehensive data protection law was done by the committee
it was necessary for the parliamentary committee to draft a new law
answer: the parliamentary committee drafted a comprehensive data protection law
explanation: Dangling Modifier: Sentence ek participle phrase 'Recognizing...' se shuru ho raha hai. Iska matlab hai ki comma ke theek baad wahi subject aana chahiye jisne yeh 'recognize' (pehchana) kiya hai. Ek law ya 'it' kuch recognize nahi kar sakta, sirf ek 'committee' kar sakti hai. Isliye committee ka aage aana zaroori hai. Vulnerabilities matlab 'kamzoriyan'.
trick: Comma ke theek baad wo insaan ya body dhoondo jo action (recognize) kar rahi hai. Law khud ko recognize nahi karega.
tip: Participle phrases (-ing se shuru) ke theek baad active subject chahiye.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The newly appointed chairman, as well as the independent directors of the board, ____________.
options: are expected to testify before the regulatory tribunal next week
is expected to testify before the regulatory tribunal next week
have expected to testify before the regulatory tribunal next week
were expected to testifying before the regulatory tribunal next week
answer: is expected to testify before the regulatory tribunal next week
explanation: Subject-Verb Agreement: Jab subjects 'as well as', 'along with', ya 'together with' se judte hain, toh verb hamesha pehle subject ke according lagta hai. Yahan pehla subject 'chairman' (singular) hai, isliye singular verb 'is' aayega. Directors (plural) hone se koi farq nahi padta. Testify matlab 'gawahi dena'.
trick: 'As well as' ke baad wale hisse ko brackets mein daal ke chupa do. Ab 'The chairman ___ expected' padho. 'Is' ekdam fit baithega.
tip: 'As well as' wale sentence mein pehle subject par focus karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: It is absolutely imperative that the municipal corporation ____________.
options: allocates sufficient funds for the rehabilitation of displaced vendors
allocate sufficient funds for the rehabilitation of displaced vendors
must allocate sufficient funds for the rehabilitation of displaced vendors
should allocates sufficient funds for the rehabilitation of displaced vendors
answer: allocate sufficient funds for the rehabilitation of displaced vendors
explanation: Subjunctive Mood: Words jaise 'imperative', 'crucial', 'essential' ke baad jab 'that' clause aata hai, toh aage aane wala verb hamesha base form (V1) mein hota hai, bina kisi 's/es' ya modal (must/should) ke. Isliye corporation singular hone ke baad bhi 'allocate' aayega, 'allocates' nahi. Imperative matlab 'ati avashyak'.
trick: 'It is imperative/crucial that' dekhte hi samajh lo ki aage wala verb apni sabse basic form (bina s/es/ed) mein aayega.
tip: Subjunctive mood hamesha plural jaisa dikhne wala base verb (V1) leta hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The central administration has introduced a slew of stringent labor reforms with a view to ____________.
options: attract foreign direct investment in the manufacturing sector
attracting foreign direct investment in the manufacturing sector
attracted foreign direct investment in the manufacturing sector
be attracting foreign direct investment in the manufacturing sector
answer: attracting foreign direct investment in the manufacturing sector
explanation: Prepositional Idiom: Phrase 'with a view to' ka matlab 'ke uddeshya se' hota hai. Is phrase mein 'to' ek preposition hai, infinitive marker (to + V1) nahi. Preposition ke baad hamesha gerund (V1+ing) aata hai. Isliye 'attracting' sahi hai, 'attract' galat. Stringent matlab 'kathor'.
trick: 'With a view to' aur 'Look forward to' English ke exception hain jahan 'to' ke baad humesha 'ing' form aati hai.
tip: 'With a view to' ke baad hamesha gerund (V+ing) ka use hota hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: By the time the antitrust watchdog initiated a formal probe into the monopolistic practices, ____________.
options: the tech conglomerate already acquired its primary competitors
the tech conglomerate has already acquired its primary competitors
the tech conglomerate had already acquired its primary competitors
the tech conglomerate would have already acquired its primary competitors
answer: the tech conglomerate had already acquired its primary competitors
explanation: Past Perfect Tense Indicator: 'By the time + Simple Past (initiated)' dikhata hai ki past ke ek point se pehle hi koi dusra kaam poora ho chuka tha. Jo kaam pehle poora ho gaya, usey Past Perfect (had + V3) mein likhte hain. Isliye 'had already acquired' aayega. Probe matlab 'jaanch' aur conglomerate matlab 'bada vyaparik samooh'.
trick: 'By the time' ke baad agar verb ki 2nd form (V2) hai, toh doosre part mein pakka 'had + V3' aayega.
tip: Past mein do actions hone par pehla action hamesha Past Perfect leta hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The opposition leaders accused the ruling party not only of mismanaging the agrarian crisis ____________.
options: but also of suppressing dissenting voices in the media
but also they suppressed dissenting voices in the media
but suppressing dissenting voices in the media
and also of suppressing dissenting voices in the media
answer: but also of suppressing dissenting voices in the media
explanation: Parallelism with Prepositions: 'not only... but also' ka rule yahan prepositional level par lag raha hai. 'not only' ke theek baad 'of + V+ing' (of mismanaging) aaya hai, toh 'but also' ke theek baad bhi 'of + V+ing' (of suppressing) aana zaroori hai taaki balance bana rahe. Dissenting matlab 'virodh karne wala'.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The sovereign wealth fund plans to invest heavily in renewable energy startups, despite ____________.

explanation: Preposition vs Conjunction: 'Despite' ek preposition hai jiske baad ek Noun ya Noun Phrase aana chahiye, pura clause (subject + verb) nahi. Option 4 mein direct clause hai jo galat hai. 'Despite of' grammar mein exist nahi karta. 'the fact that' ek noun phrase banata hai jo aage clause ko sahara deta hai. Hurdles matlab 'badhayein'.
trick: Despite ke baad directly clause nahi lagta aur 'despite' ke sath 'of' kabhi nahi lagta. 'the fact that' bridge ka kaam karta hai.
tip: 'Despite' ke baad puri line likhni ho toh 'the fact that' lagana padta hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The seasoned diplomat handled the delicate peace negotiations with such remarkable tact ____________.

explanation: Correlative Pair 'Such... that': Jab bhi hum kisi cheez ki extreme degree ('such remarkable tact' - itni shandaar chaturai) batate hain aur uska result dikhana hota hai, toh hum 'such... that' ka pair use karte hain. 'Such... as' relative pronoun ki tarah use hota hai, par yahan result (ceasefire) dikhaya ja raha hai isliye 'that' aayega. Tact matlab 'kushalta/samajhdari'.
trick: Sentence mein 'such + noun' dekha? Toh aage uska result batane ke liye directly 'that' lagao, 'so that' ya 'as' nahi.
tip: Cause-effect structures mein 'such' ke baad hamesha 'that' aata hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The commercial banks were instructed to maintain higher cash reserves lest ____________.

they should face a severe liquidity crunch during the festive season

explanation: Conjunction Pair 'Lest... should': 'Lest' ka matlab hota hai 'kahin aisa na ho ki'. Grammar mein lest ke baad aane wale clause mein hamesha modal 'should' aata hai (kabhi-kabhi base V1 bhi allowed hai, par 'should' standard hai). Lest khud ek negative word hai, isliye aage 'not' nahi lag sakta. Liquidity crunch matlab 'nagdi ki kami'.
trick: 'Lest' dikhe toh aage waale hisse mein sirf 'should' dhoondo aur check karo ki 'not' toh nahi laga. Agar not hai toh wo galat hai.
tip: 'Lest' ke sath hamesha 'should' aata hai aur negative words use nahi hote.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Many financial analysts are skeptical about whether the newly proposed cryptocurrency regulations ____________.

'Whether' ke baad humein bas subject (regulations) aur verb (will curb) chahiye. Wapas 'that' ya 'if' lagana redundancy (faltu dohrav) hai. Tense present (are skeptical) se future result ki baat ho rahi hai isliye 'will' aayega. Illicit matlab 'avaidh'.
trick: Sentence mein already 'whether' aa chuka hai, isliye options mein 'that' ya 'if' wale choices turant eliminate kar do.
tip: 'Whether' aur 'that/if' kabhi ek sath ek hi clause mein nahi aate.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The infrastructure overhaul requires the government to construct new highways, modernize existing ports, and ____________.

Yahan list hai: 'to construct', '(to) modernize', and '(to) upgrade'. Isliye 'and' ke baad siraf 'upgrade' aayega, 'upgrading' ya 'to upgrade' repetition hoga.
trick: List padho: construct (V1), modernize (V1), toh 'and' ke baad bhi sidha V1 (upgrade) hi aayega.
tip: Infinitive ki list mein 'to' ko baar-baar repeat nahi kiya jata hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Seldom ____________ a structural transformation of this magnitude without encountering stiff resistance from vested interests.

explanation: Rule of Inversion: Jab koi sentence negative adverb jaise 'Seldom', 'Never', 'Rarely', 'Hardly' se shuru hota hai, toh Subject aur Verb apni jagah badal lete hain (Inversion). Pehle Helping Verb aata hai, phir Subject. Isliye 'has an emerging economy witnessed' sahi structure hai. Option 3 mein 'did' ke sath V1 aana chahiye, V2 nahi. Vested interests matlab 'niyantrit swarth'.
trick: 'Seldom' sentence ke shuru mein hai? Toh uske theek baad helping verb (has/have/do/did) aayega, subject nahi.
tip: Negative words se sentence start ho toh Inversion (HV + Subject) apply karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The core objective of the monetary policy is as much about stimulating sustainable economic growth ____________.

explanation: Comparative Correlatives & Parallelism: 'as much' ka exact comparison pair 'as' hota hai, 'than' ya 'like' nahi. Comparison dono equal situations ke beech ho raha hai: 'about stimulating...' aur 'about containing...'. Grammatically complete hone ke liye clause 'as it is about containing...' balance provide karta hai.

tip: 'As much' hamesha 'as' se follow hota hai taaki equality dikha sake.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Had the health ministry proactively stockpiled the essential antiviral drugs, ____________.

explanation: Third Conditional (Unreal Past): Sentence 'Had + Subject + V3' (Had the ministry stockpiled) se start ho raha hai, jo past ki unreal condition dikhata hai (jo hua nahi). Iske result clause mein hamesha 'would have + V3' ka use hota hai. Stockpiled matlab 'bhandaran karna' aur mortality rate matlab 'mrityu dar'.
trick: Sentence ki shuruaat mein 'Had + V3' dekha? Toh seedha options mein 'would have + V3' dhoondo aur wahi mark karo.
tip: Past unfulfilled condition mein formula: If+Past Perfect, ...would have+V3.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The investigative journalist exposed the corporate scam, revealing how shell companies ____________.

have been used for laundering money across borders

explanation: Tense Agreement & Passive Continuous: Main verb 'exposed' (Simple Past) hai. Isliye aage ki situation bhi past continuous mein hogi kyunki action past mein kisi dauran chal raha tha. Shell companies khud use nahi hoti thi, koi aur kar raha tha, isliye Passive Voice 'were being used' aayega. Preposition 'for' ke sath gerund 'laundering' fit hota hai.

tip: Jab main verb past mein ho, toh subordinate clause bhi past follow karega.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Despite the optimism surrounding the initial public offering, nearly three-fourths of the equity ____________.

explanation: Fractions & Subject-Verb Agreement: Fraction (e.g., half of, two-thirds of, three-fourths of) ke baad aane wala Noun decide karta hai ki verb kya hoga. Yahan noun 'equity' hai, jo ki Uncountable (singular) hota hai. Isliye singular verb 'was' aayega, 'were' ya 'have' nahi. Subscribed matlab 'khareed lena'.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Neither the aggressive marketing campaigns nor the steep festive discounts ____________.

explanation: Proximity Rule of Subject-Verb Agreement: Jab do subjects 'neither... nor' se judte hain, toh verb hamesha apne paas wale (second) subject ke hisaab se lagta hai. Yahan verb ke paas 'steep festive discounts' (Plural) hai. Isliye plural verb 'have' aayega. Plummeting matlab 'tezi se girti hui'.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The board of directors is willing to ratify the controversial merger, provided that ____________.

trick: 'Provided that' bilkul 'If' ki tarah behave karta hai. 'If' wale hisse mein 'will' nahi aata, isliye option 1 cancel. Tense present hai, toh option 3 sahi hai.
tip: 'Provided that' (If) clause mein future tense (will) ka prayog galat hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The revised foreign trade policy focuses not merely on augmenting the volume of merchandise exports ____________.

tip: Correlative conjunctions hamesha exact same grammatical structure (Parallelism) follow karte hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Should the geopolitical conflicts escalate further, disrupting the global supply of crucial semiconductors, ____________.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: To tackle the impending climate crisis, policymakers must incentivize green energy, penalize excessive carbon emissions, and ____________.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: An analysis of the recent corporate earnings reveals that neither the persistent global headwinds nor the domestic liquidity crunch ____________.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The more seamlessly the government integrates informal businesses into the formal economy, ____________.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The primary reason for the unexpected contraction in the gross domestic product is ____________.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: No sooner had the regulatory authority relaxed the environmental clearance norms for mining projects ____________.
