explanation: Correlative Pair 'No sooner... than': 'No sooner' ka matlab hota hai 'jaise hi... waise hi'. Kyunki isme 'sooner' ek comparative degree ka word hai, iske sath humesha comparative conjunction 'than' (T-H-A-N) lagta hai. 'when' 'hardly/scarcely' ke sath lagta hai, aur 'then' (samay wala) grammar wise galat hai.
trick: 'No sooner' mein aakhiri 'er' (comparative) par dhyan do. Comparatives apne sath humesha T-H-A-N lete hain.
tip: 'No sooner' ka proper grammatical pair sirf 'than' hota hai, 'when' nahi.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The beleaguered aviation sector will continue to bleed capital profusely unless ____________.
options: the global prices of aviation turbine fuel do not stabilize soon
the global prices of aviation turbine fuel stabilize soon
the global prices of aviation turbine fuel will stabilize soon
the global prices of aviation turbine fuel will not stabilize soon
answer: the global prices of aviation turbine fuel stabilize soon
explanation: Conditionals with 'Unless': 'Unless' ka matlab 'If not' (jab tak ki nahi) hota hai. First, iske baad aane wale clause mein negative word (not/do not) nahi lag sakta. Second, First Conditional mein unless/if clause humesha Simple Present Tense ('stabilize') mein hota hai jab main clause Future Tense ('will continue') mein ho. Beleaguered matlab 'musibaton se ghira hua'.
trick: 'Unless' wale hisse mein 'not' lagna bilkul galat hai, aur time clause mein future (will) lagna bhi galat hai. Toh Simple Present positive option (stabilize) hi bachta hai.
tip: Unless clause mein 'not' aur future tense ('will/shall') ka use nahi hota.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Although the bilateral free trade agreement is expected to eliminate major tariffs, ____________.
options: but the domestic manufacturers remain deeply apprehensive about cheap imports
the domestic manufacturers remain deeply apprehensive about cheap imports
yet the domestic manufacturers remain deeply apprehensive about cheap imports
despite the domestic manufacturers remaining deeply apprehensive about cheap imports
answer: the domestic manufacturers remain deeply apprehensive about cheap imports
explanation: Conjunction Redundancy: Modern standard English mein jab sentence 'Although' ya 'Though' se shuru hota hai, toh doosre (main) clause ko jodne ke liye 'but' ya kisi aur opposing conjunction ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Sirf ek comma (,) kaafi hota hai. 'but' lagana superflous error kehlata hai. Apprehensive matlab 'chintit ya dara hua'.
trick: Agar pehla word 'Although' ya 'Though' hai, toh coma ke baad wale option mein 'but' ya 'despite' dekhte hi usko kaat do.
tip: 'Although/Though' ke sath main clause mein 'but' ka prayog vyakaran ke anusaar galat hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The steep depreciation of the domestic currency, coupled with surging global commodity prices, ____________.
options: have exacerbated the inflationary pressures in the economy
are exacerbating the inflationary pressures in the economy
were exacerbating the inflationary pressures in the economy
has exacerbated the inflationary pressures in the economy
answer: has exacerbated the inflationary pressures in the economy
explanation: Subject-Verb Agreement (Parenthetical Phrases): Jab do nouns 'coupled with', 'along with', ya 'accompanied by' se jude hote hain, toh humesha original (pehle) subject ke anusaar verb lagate hain. Yahan asli subject 'depreciation' (girawat) hai jo ki uncountable (singular) hai. Doosra part commas ke beech mein extra information hai. Isliye singular verb 'has' aayega. Exacerbated matlab 'aur bigaad dena'.
trick: Commas ke beech wale hisse ('coupled with...') ko hide kar do. Pado: 'The steep depreciation ___ exacerbated'. Saaf taur par singular verb 'has' match karega.
tip: Words like 'coupled with' ko ignore karke hamesha pehle main subject par focus karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The central bank must remain vigilant and incrementally tighten the monetary policy lest ____________.
options: the economy should slip into a prolonged period of stagflation
the economy should not slip into a prolonged period of stagflation
the economy will slip into a prolonged period of stagflation
the economy might slip into a prolonged period of stagflation
answer: the economy should slip into a prolonged period of stagflation
explanation: Lest vs Should Rule: 'Lest' ek negative conjunction hai jiska matlab 'kahin aisa na ho ki' hota hai. Grammatically, 'lest' ke baad aane wale clause mein humesha modal verb 'should' ka use hota hai (ya base verb ka). Sath hi, kyunki lest khud negative hai, iske sath 'not' ka use redundant aur galat ho jata hai. Stagflation matlab 'mehngai ke sath arthik mandi'.
trick: 'Lest' dekha toh options mein 'should' dhoondo, aur is baat ka dhyaan rakho ki us 'should' ke aage 'not' na laga ho.
tip: 'Lest' hamesha 'should' ke sath pair hota hai aur isme additional negatives use nahi hote.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Plagued by non-performing assets and inadequate capital buffers, ____________.
options: the central bank had to inevitably rescue the cooperative bank
it was inevitable for the cooperative bank to be rescued
the bailout of the cooperative bank by the central bank was inevitable
the cooperative bank had to inevitably be rescued by the central bank
answer: the cooperative bank had to inevitably be rescued by the central bank
explanation: Dangling Participle (Modifier Alignment): Sentence shuru hota hai past participle phrase 'Plagued by...' (pareshan hokar) se. Grammatical rule yeh hai ki comma ke theek baad wahi noun aana chahiye jiski yeh phrase charcha kar raha ho. Central bank ya 'it' plagued nahi tha, balki 'cooperative bank' kharab loans se pareshan tha. Isliye cooperative bank sentence ka active subject hona zaroori hai.
trick: Socho 'Plagued by NPAs' kaun tha? Bank jiske loan kharab the (cooperative bank). Toh comma ke theek baad usi ka aana tay hai.
tip: Modifier phrase ke turant baad us phrase se related proper Subject place karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: A successful modern executive must be highly analytical, technologically proficient, and ____________.
options: possess exceptional communication skills
to have exceptional communication skills
possessing exceptional communication skills
exceptionally communicative
answer: exceptionally communicative
explanation: Rule of Parallelism (Adjectives): Sentence mein ek parallel list ban rahi hai describing characteristics. Format yeh hai: Adverb + Adjective ('highly analytical'), Adverb + Adjective ('technologically proficient'). Isliye 'and' ke baad aane wala aakhri tatv bhi Adverb + Adjective ke format mein hona chahiye, jo ki 'exceptionally communicative' hai. Baaki options verbs ya noun phrases introduce karke symmetry todte hain.
trick: Series mein pichle words dekho: 'analytical' aur 'proficient' dono visheshan (adjectives) hain, toh 'and' ke baad bhi adjective ('communicative') hi aayega.
tip: List mein sabhi items ka part of speech hamesha identical hona chahiye.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The revised agricultural policy emphasizes not only incentivizing organic farming methods ____________.
options: but also to provide subsidies for solar water pumps
but it also provides subsidies for solar water pumps
but also providing subsidies for solar water pumps
and also on providing subsidies for solar water pumps
answer: but also providing subsidies for solar water pumps
explanation: Parallelism Rule: 'not only... but also' wale sentences mein dono taraf same grammatical structure chahiye. 'not only' ke baad 'incentivizing' (gerund) aaya hai, toh 'but also' ke baad bhi 'providing' (gerund) aayega. Options 1 aur 2 galat hain kyunki unmein infinitive ya naya clause use hua hai. Emphasizes ka matlab 'zor dena' aur incentivizing ka 'protsahit karna'.
trick: Sentence mein 'not only' ke theek baad 'ing' form (incentivizing) hai, toh 'but also' ke theek baad bhi 'ing' form dhundo.
tip: Correlative conjunctions hamesha strict parallel structure follow karte hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Faced with an unprecedented liquidity crunch, ____________.
options: a massive bailout package was announced by the central government
the central government announced a massive bailout package
the announcement of a massive bailout package was made by the government
it was imperative for the government to announce a bailout package
answer: the central government announced a massive bailout package
explanation: Dangling Modifier Rule: Sentence ek adjectival phrase 'Faced with...' se shuru ho raha hai. Is phrase ka logical subject wo hona chahiye jo is 'liquidity crunch' (nagdi ki kami) ko face kar raha ho. Ek 'package' ya 'announcement' ise face nahi kar sakta, sirf 'government' ya koi authority face kar sakti hai. Isliye comma ke theek baad active subject 'the central government' aana zaroori hai. Unprecedented matlab 'abhootpoorv'.
trick: Comma ke theek baad us entity ka naam dhoondo jo sentence ke shuruaati hisse ka action (faced with) kar sakti ho.
tip: Introductory modifier ke theek baad uska logical subject aana chahiye.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The latest economic survey highlights that the number of highly skilled professionals emigrating to developed nations ____________.
options: have reached an all-time high over the past decade
are reaching an all-time high over the past decade
has reached an all-time high over the past decade
were reaching an all-time high over the past decade
answer: has reached an all-time high over the past decade
explanation: Subject-Verb Agreement ('The number of' vs 'A number of'): Grammar ka rule kehta hai ki 'The number of' ke baad noun plural hota hai (professionals) lekin verb hamesha singular aati hai kyunki hum ek specific aakde (figure) ki baat kar rahe hain. Isliye singular verb 'has reached' aayega, 'have' ya 'are' nahi. Emigrating matlab 'apna desh chhodkar doosre desh basna'.
trick: 'The number of' dekhte hi samajh jao ki verb singular (has/is/was) hogi. 'A number of' hota toh verb plural (have/are) aati.
tip: 'The number of' hamesha singular verb leta hai, noun plural hone par bhi.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: If the global supply chain disruptions had been resolved earlier this year, ____________.
options: the manufacturing output will not plummet so drastically
the manufacturing output would not plummet so drastically
the manufacturing output would not have plummeted so drastically
the manufacturing output had not plummeted so drastically
answer: the manufacturing output would not have plummeted so drastically
explanation: Third Conditional (Unreal Past Condition): Jab if-clause mein Past Perfect (had been resolved) aata hai, toh iska matlab hai ki hum past ki kisi aisi condition ki baat kar rahe hain jo puri nahi hui. Iske result/main clause mein hamesha 'would have + V3' ka use hota hai. Plummeted matlab 'tezi se girna/khatam hona'.
trick: If wale hisse mein 'had + V3' dikhe, toh options mein turant 'would have + V3' wala combination dhoond kar mark kar do.
tip: Third conditional ka fixed structure: If + Past Perfect, would have + V3.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The new corporate governance guidelines make it absolutely mandatory that every listed entity ____________.
options: discloses its quarterly carbon footprint reports transparently
disclose its quarterly carbon footprint reports transparently
must disclose its quarterly carbon footprint reports transparently
should discloses its quarterly carbon footprint reports transparently
answer: disclose its quarterly carbon footprint reports transparently
explanation: Subjunctive Mood: Jab verbs ya adjectives like 'mandatory', 'imperative', 'essential', 'demand', 'insist' aate hain, toh aage aane wale 'that' clause mein verb hamesha apni base form (V1 bina s/es/ed) mein hota hai, chahe subject (every listed entity) singular hi kyu na ho. Isliye 'disclose' aayega, 'discloses' ya 'must disclose' nahi. Entity matlab 'sanstha'.
trick: 'Mandatory that' dekhte hi aage aane wale action verb ko uski sabse basic form (bina 's' ya 'es') mein select karo.
tip: Subjunctive sentences mein 'that' ke baad base verb (V1) lagaya jata hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Ever since the apex court unequivocally struck down the controversial electoral bonds scheme, ____________.
options: corporate funding to political parties has become significantly more opaque
corporate funding to political parties became significantly more opaque
corporate funding to political parties had become significantly more opaque
corporate funding to political parties is becoming significantly more opaque
answer: corporate funding to political parties has become significantly more opaque
explanation: Tense Rules for 'Since': Jab 'ever since' ek point of time (past ki ghatna) ko show karta hai, toh 'since' ke baad wala time clause Simple Past (struck down) mein hota hai, aur main clause hamesha Present Perfect (has become) mein hota hai, kyunki uska asar abhi tak hai. Unequivocally matlab 'spasht roop se' aur opaque matlab 'aparadarshi'.
trick: 'Ever since' ke baad V2 (struck) hai, toh dusre hisse mein hamesha 'has/have + V3' aayega.
tip: 'Since' wale time reference mein main clause Present Perfect tense leta hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Hardly had the finance minister concluded her budget speech outlining the ambitious privatization drive ____________.
options: than the stock market indices plummeted sharply
then the stock market indices plummeted sharply
when the stock market indices plummeted sharply
that the stock market indices plummeted sharply
answer: when the stock market indices plummeted sharply
explanation: Inversion & Conjunction Pairing: 'Hardly' aur 'Scarcely' negative adverbs hain. Inke baad pehle helping verb aur fir subject aata hai (had the minister concluded). Inka conjunction pair hamesha 'when' ya 'before' hota hai, 'than' ya 'then' nahi. 'Than' hamesha 'No sooner' ke sath lagta hai. Plummeted matlab 'tezi se girna'.
trick: Hardly/Scarcely = when. No sooner = than. Tense check karo (had + V3), isliye aage 'when' hi aayega.
tip: Hardly aur Scarcely ka proper conjunction pair 'when' hota hai, 'than' nahi.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The board of directors plans to appoint a seasoned economist, one ____________.
options: whom they believe can navigate the impending recession effectively
who they believe can navigate the impending recession effectively
which they believe can navigate the impending recession effectively
who can be believed to navigate the impending recession effectively
answer: who they believe can navigate the impending recession effectively
explanation: Relative Pronoun (Who vs Whom): Sentence mein 'they believe' ek embedded/extra clause hai. Aise questions mein 'they believe' ko mind mein delete karke dekhein. Ab sentence bacha: '...one ___ can navigate'. Yahan verb (can navigate) ko ek subject ki zaroorat hai, isliye subject pronoun 'who' aayega, object pronoun 'whom' nahi. Impending matlab 'sir par mandraata hua'.
trick: Sentence mein se 'they believe' ya 'I think' ko hide karke padho. Agar seedha verb (can navigate) bacha hai, toh humesha 'who' lagao.
tip: Verb ko subject chahiye hota hai, isliye embedded clause hata kar 'who' lagayein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: To ensure a robust economic recovery, the central administration must focus on generating employment, controlling inflation, and ____________.
options: to stabilize the volatile foreign exchange reserves
stabilizing the volatile foreign exchange reserves
stabilize the volatile foreign exchange reserves
the stabilization of the volatile foreign exchange reserves
answer: stabilizing the volatile foreign exchange reserves
explanation: Parallelism in Lists: Sentence mein preposition 'on' ke baad aane wali list gerunds (V1+ing) ki chal rahi hai - 'generating', 'controlling'. Isliye 'and' ke baad aane wala teesra element bhi grammatically same, yani gerund form (stabilizing) mein hi hona chahiye. Robust matlab 'mazboot' aur volatile matlab 'asthi/charchil'.
trick: List ke pehle do words (generating, controlling) 'ing' form mein hain, toh teesra option bhi 'ing' (stabilizing) wala hi correct hoga.
tip: Comma se judi hui items (lists) hamesha same grammatical parts of speech leti hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The diplomatic delegates are sincerely looking forward ____________.
options: to resolve the long-standing border dispute peacefully
to resolving the long-standing border dispute peacefully
for resolving the long-standing border dispute peacefully
in resolving the long-standing border dispute peacefully
answer: to resolving the long-standing border dispute peacefully
explanation: Prepositional Idiom: Kuch fixed English phrases jaise 'look forward to', 'accustomed to', 'prone to', aur 'with a view to' ke baad infinitive (V1) nahi aata, balki hamesha gerund (V1+ing) aata hai. Yahan preposition 'to' ke baad noun form aani hoti hai, isliye 'resolving' aayega. Dispute matlab 'vivaad'.
trick: Dhyan rakhein ki 'Look forward to' un gine-chune phrases mein se hai jahan 'to' ke theek baad verb ki 'ing' form (gerund) aati hai.
tip: 'Looking forward to' ke theek baad hamesha gerund (V1+ing) ka prayog karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Neither the prolonged geopolitical tensions nor the aggressive tightening of monetary policy ____________.
options: have managed to significantly derail the domestic growth trajectory
are managing to significantly derail the domestic growth trajectory
has managed to significantly derail the domestic growth trajectory
manage to significantly derail the domestic growth trajectory
answer: has managed to significantly derail the domestic growth trajectory
explanation: Proximity Rule of Subject-Verb Agreement: Jab do subjects 'neither... nor' ya 'either... or' se judte hain, toh verb hamesha apne paas wale (second) subject ke hisaab se lagta hai. Yahan verb ke theek pehle 'aggressive tightening' hai, jo ki ek singular, uncountable concept hai. Isliye singular verb 'has' aayega. Derail matlab 'patri se utarna'.
trick: Neither-Nor wale vakya mein 'Nor' ke theek baad kya likha hai uspe focus karo. 'Tightening' singular hai, toh verb (has) bhi singular aayegi.
tip: Neither...nor mein verb hamesha nearest subject ke number se agree karti hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The sovereign wealth fund plans to invest heavily in renewable energy infrastructure, despite ____________.
options: that the sector is currently facing severe regulatory bottlenecks
the fact that the sector is currently facing severe regulatory bottlenecks
of the fact that the sector is currently facing severe regulatory bottlenecks
the sector is currently facing severe regulatory bottlenecks
answer: the fact that the sector is currently facing severe regulatory bottlenecks
explanation: Preposition vs Conjunction: 'Despite' ek preposition hai jiske baad directly ek clause (subject + verb) nahi aa sakta. Option 4 galat hai. 'Despite of' grammar mein exist nahi karta ('in spite of' hota hai). Isliye clause jodne ke liye 'the fact that' ka sahara lena padta hai jo ek noun phrase banata hai. Sovereign wealth fund matlab 'sarkari nivesh kosh'.
trick: Despite ke baad directly poori line (clause) nahi judti aur 'despite' ke sath 'of' bilkul nahi lagta. 'The fact that' ek bridge ka kaam karta hai.
tip: 'Despite' ke baad pura clause likhna ho toh 'the fact that' lagana padta hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The more aggressively the central bank intervenes to artificially stabilize the depreciating currency, ____________.
options: the more higher the risk of depleting the foreign exchange reserves
the greater the risk of depleting the foreign exchange reserves
greater is the risk of depleting the foreign exchange reserves
the risk of depleting the foreign exchange reserves becomes greater
answer: the greater the risk of depleting the foreign exchange reserves
explanation: Double Comparatives: Jab do continuous badhne ya ghatne wali cheezon ka zikar ho (proportionate change), toh structure hamesha 'The + Comparative ... , The + Comparative ...' hota hai. Pehla hissa 'The more aggressively' se shuru hai, toh doosra hissa bhi 'The + Comparative' se hoga. 'more higher' ek double comparative error hai. 'the greater' sahi format hai. Depleting matlab 'khatam hona/kam hona'.
trick: Comma se pehle 'The + -er / more' dekho. Comma ke baad options mein waisa hi phrase dhundo jiski shuruat bina grammatical error wale 'The + -er' se ho.
tip: Parallel comparatives structure: The + comparative, the + comparative format yaad rakhein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The finance ministry is willing to ratify the controversial bank privatization bill, provided that ____________.
options: the acquiring entities will absorb all the existing toxic liabilities
the acquiring entities absorbed all the existing toxic liabilities
the acquiring entities absorb all the existing toxic liabilities
the acquiring entities would absorb all the existing toxic liabilities
answer: the acquiring entities absorb all the existing toxic liabilities
explanation: First Conditional with 'Provided that': 'Provided that' bilkul 'If' (shart) ki tarah kaam karta hai. Jab main clause Present Tense ya Future ('is willing') mein hota hai, toh if-clause / provided-clause hamesha Simple Present Tense ('absorb') mein hota hai. Future tense ('will absorb') ya Past ('absorbed') lagana galat hai. Ratify matlab 'manzoori dena' aur toxic liabilities matlab 'doobe hue loans'.
trick: 'Provided that' if-clause jaisa hai. 'If' wale hisse mein 'will' ya 'would' nahi aata. Tense present hai, toh base verb (absorb) wala option chuno.
tip: 'Provided that' (Condition) clause mein future tense ('will') ka use galat hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The newly appointed chairman, as well as the independent directors of the board, ____________.
options: are expected to testify before the regulatory tribunal next Tuesday
have expected to testify before the regulatory tribunal next Tuesday
were expected to testifying before the regulatory tribunal next Tuesday
is expected to testify before the regulatory tribunal next Tuesday
answer: is expected to testify before the regulatory tribunal next Tuesday
explanation: Subject-Verb Agreement (Parenthetical Additions): Jab do subjects 'as well as', 'along with', ya 'accompanied by' se judte hain, toh verb hamesha pehle main subject ke according lagta hai. Yahan pehla subject 'chairman' (singular) hai. Isliye singular verb 'is' aayega. Directors (plural) hone se fark nahi padta. Testify matlab 'gawahi dena'.
trick: Sentence mein 'as well as' ke baad wale hisse ko brackets mein daal kar bhool jao. 'The chairman ___ expected'. Saaf taur par 'is' lagega.
tip: 'As well as' wale sentence mein verb hamesha pehle subject ke anusaar aati hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The primary reason for the sudden contraction in the gross domestic product is ____________.
options: because household consumption dropped drastically during the festive quarter
due to household consumption dropping drastically during the festive quarter
how household consumption dropped drastically during the festive quarter
that household consumption dropped drastically during the festive quarter
answer: that household consumption dropped drastically during the festive quarter
explanation: Noun Clause for Subject Complement: 'The reason is...' construction ke baad hum karan batane ke liye hamesha 'that' se shuru hone wala Noun Clause use karte hain. 'Because' ya 'due to' ka use karna superflous (faltu) hota hai kyunki 'reason' shabd mein pehle se hi 'karan' ka arth shamil hai. Contraction matlab 'sikudna/arthvyavastha ka girna'.
trick: Sentence ki shuruat mein 'The reason... is' dekhte hi blanks mein baaki sab reject karke sirf 'that' wala option tick karein.
tip: 'The reason is' ke baad hamesha 'that' aata hai, 'because' ya 'due to' nahi.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The municipal corporation was instructed to strictly enforce the anti-encroachment drive lest ____________.
options: the city will descend into total infrastructural chaos during the monsoons
the city should descend into total infrastructural chaos during the monsoons
the city should not descend into total infrastructural chaos during the monsoons
the city would descend into total infrastructural chaos during the monsoons
answer: the city should descend into total infrastructural chaos during the monsoons
explanation: Lest vs Should Rule: 'Lest' ek negative conjunction hai jiska arth hota hai 'kahin aisa na ho ki'. Grammar mein lest ke baad aane wale clause mein humesha modal verb 'should' lagta hai. Lest khud negative meaning rakhta hai, isliye uske baad aane wale clause mein 'not' ka use redundant (galat) hota hai. Encroachment matlab 'atikraman/kabza'.
trick: 'Lest' dekha toh aage options mein sirf 'should' dhoondo, aur dhyan rahe ki us 'should' ke sath 'not' bilkul na laga ho.
tip: 'Lest' hamesha 'should' ke sath aata hai aur isme extra 'not' nahi lagta.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Rather than succumb to the aggressive hostile takeover bid by its arch-rival, the company ____________.
options: choosing to deliberately dilute its own share equity
chose to deliberately dilute its own share equity
chosen to deliberately dilute its own share equity
chooses to deliberately dilute its own share equity
answer: chose to deliberately dilute its own share equity
explanation: Bare Infinitive & Tense Consistency: 'Rather than' ke baad yahan bare infinitive 'succumb' (bina 'to' ke V1) use hua hai. Iska matlab action past ya present narrative ka hissa hai. 'Hostile takeover' se bachne ke liye company ne jo faisla kiya wo ek historical/completed action hai, isliye yahan Simple Past Tense 'chose' (V2) aayega. Dilute matlab 'kamzor karna' aur hostile takeover matlab 'zabarjasti kabza'.
trick: Poora sentence ek action ka result bata raha hai jo past mein finalize hua (takeover bid se bachna). Isliye V2 form (chose) sabse fitting hai.
tip: Context check karein: Completed actions ke liye Simple Past tense lagta hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Every prominent commercial bank and non-banking financial company must strictly ensure that ____________.
options: their lending protocols completely align with the updated international standards
its lending protocols completely align with the updated international standards
there lending protocols completely align with the updated international standards
it's lending protocols completely align with the updated international standards
answer: its lending protocols completely align with the updated international standards
explanation: Pronoun Antecedent Agreement ('Every'): Jab do nouns 'and' se jude hon (bank and company) lekin unke aage 'Each' ya 'Every' laga ho, toh unhe grammatically singular (ekvachan) hi maana jata hai. Isliye unke liye use hone wala possessive pronoun bhi singular 'its' hoga, 'their' nahi. 'It's' ka matlab 'it is' hota hai, isliye option 4 galat hai. Protocols matlab 'niyam'.
trick: Subject ke bilkul shuru mein 'Every' likha hai? Toh seedha option mein jao aur singular pronoun (its/his/her) wala option mark karo.
tip: 'Every' se start hone wale subjects ke liye singular possessive pronoun (its) aata hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Although the comprehensive demographic survey is expected to eliminate major statistical discrepancies, ____________.
options: but the researchers remain deeply apprehensive about the sampling methodology
yet the researchers remain deeply apprehensive about the sampling methodology
the researchers remain deeply apprehensive about the sampling methodology
despite the researchers remaining deeply apprehensive about the sampling methodology
answer: the researchers remain deeply apprehensive about the sampling methodology
explanation: Conjunction Redundancy: Standard English grammar ke anusar jab vakya 'Although' ya 'Though' se shuru hota hai, toh doosre main clause ko jodne ke liye 'but' ya kisi aur opposing conjunction ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Bas ek comma (,) lagana kaafi hota hai. 'But' ya 'yet' ka prayog superflous error kehlata hai. Apprehensive matlab 'chintit' aur discrepancies matlab 'antaro/khamiyan'.
trick: Agar pehla shabd 'Although' ya 'Though' hai, toh comma ke theek baad 'but' ya 'yet' dekh kar turant wo options eliminate kar do.
tip: 'Although/Though' ke sath main clause mein 'but' ya 'yet' ka prayog galat hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: In its bid to revamp the ailing public sector banks, the government aims not merely to infuse fresh capital ____________.
options: but it also overhauls the existing management structure
but also to overhaul the existing management structure
but also overhauling the existing management structure
and also to overhaul the existing management structure
answer: but also to overhaul the existing management structure
explanation: Rule of Parallelism: 'not merely... but also' ek correlative conjunction pair hai. Sentence mein 'not merely' ke theek baad 'to infuse' (Infinitive) aaya hai. Grammatical balance banaye rakhne ke liye 'but also' ke baad bhi 'to + V1' (to overhaul) aana chahiye. Ailing matlab 'beemar/kamzor' aur overhaul matlab 'poori tarah marammat karna'.
trick: Sentence mein 'not merely' ke aage 'to + V1' dekho. Phir turant options mein 'but also to + V1' dhoondh kar mark karo.
tip: Correlative conjunctions (not only/merely... but also) strict parallel structure follow karte hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: By the time the antitrust committee officially released its comprehensive report on monopolistic practices, ____________.
options: the tech giant had already acquired its main rival
the tech giant has already acquired its main rival
the tech giant already acquired its main rival
the tech giant will already acquire its main rival
answer: the tech giant had already acquired its main rival
explanation: Past Perfect Tense Indicator: 'By the time + Simple Past (released)' ka rule kehta hai ki past ke ek point se pehle hi agar koi aur kaam pura ho chuka tha, toh wo pehla kaam Past Perfect (had + V3) mein likha jayega. Yahan tech giant ne pehle hi rival ko khareed liya tha. Antitrust matlab 'ekadhikar-virodhi' aur acquired matlab 'adhigrahan kar lena'.
trick: 'By the time' ke baad agar V2 (released) hai, toh doosre part mein aankh band karke 'had + V3' wala option lagao.
tip: Past mein do actions hone par pehla action hamesha Past Perfect tense leta hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The newly drafted national education policy, along with the detailed implementation frameworks from state governments, ____________.
options: are scheduled to be presented in the winter session
is scheduled to be presented in the winter session
have been scheduled to be presented in the winter session
were scheduled to be presented in the winter session
answer: is scheduled to be presented in the winter session
explanation: Subject-Verb Agreement (Parenthetical Phrases): Jab do subjects 'along with', 'as well as', ya 'together with' se judte hain, toh verb humesha pehle/main subject ke according aati hai. Main subject 'national education policy' (singular) hai. Isliye singular verb 'is' aayega, chahe 'frameworks' (plural) commas ke beech mein ho. Drafted matlab 'masouda tayyar kiya hua'.
trick: Commas ke beech wale hisse (along with...) ko ignore karo. 'The policy ___ scheduled'. 'Is' fit baithta hai.
tip: 'Along with' ko ignore karke hamesha pehle subject (Policy) par focus karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Severely battered by the prolonged supply-chain bottlenecks and geopolitical tensions, ____________.
options: a massive dip in quarterly profits was reported by the manufacturing hub
the manufacturing hub reported a massive dip in quarterly profits
reporting a massive dip in quarterly profits was inevitable for the hub
it was inevitable that the manufacturing hub reported a massive dip
answer: the manufacturing hub reported a massive dip in quarterly profits
explanation: Dangling Participle (Modifier Alignment): Sentence ek participle phrase 'Severely battered by...' (buri tarah prabhavit hokar) se shuru hua hai. Rule ke hisaab se comma ke theek baad wahi noun aana chahiye jo actually 'battered' hua hai. Profits ya 'it' battered nahi hue, balki 'manufacturing hub' battered hua. Isliye hub sentence ka active subject hona zaroori hai. Battered matlab 'nuksan pahuncha hua'.
trick: Socho ki 'battered' kaun hua? Manufacturing hub. Toh comma ke theek baad 'hub' ka aana tay hai.
tip: Modifier phrase ke turant baad us phrase ka real karta (doer/subject) place karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The supreme environmental authority mandates that every heavy-industry conglomerate ____________.
options: must transitions to renewable energy sources by 2030
transitions to renewable energy sources by 2030
transition to renewable energy sources by 2030
should transitions to renewable energy sources by 2030
answer: transition to renewable energy sources by 2030
explanation: Subjunctive Mood: Words jaise 'mandate', 'demand', 'insist', 'imperative' ke baad aane wale 'that' clause mein verb hamesha apni base form (V1 bina s/es/ed) mein hota hai. Isliye 'every conglomerate' (singular) hone ke bawajood 'transition' aayega, 'transitions' ya 'must transition' nahi. Conglomerate matlab 'bada udyog samooh'.
trick: Agar sentence mein 'mandates that' ya 'insists that' hai, toh aage V1 form dhundo jisme 's' ya 'es' na laga ho.
tip: Subjunctive clauses (mandate that) mein hamesha subject ke baad Base Verb (V1) lagta hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Seldom ____________ such a catastrophic failure of the macroeconomic regulatory framework in a rapidly developing nation.
options: an emerging market has witnessed
has an emerging market witnessed
an emerging market witnesses
did an emerging market witnessed
answer: has an emerging market witnessed
explanation: Rule of Inversion: Jab koi sentence negative adverbs jaise 'Seldom', 'Hardly', 'Scarcely', 'Never' se shuru hota hai, toh usme Inversion apply hota hai. Matlab, Helping Verb subject se pehle aati hai (HV + Subject + Main Verb). Isliye 'has an emerging market witnessed' sahi format hai. Catastrophic matlab 'vinashkari'.
trick: 'Seldom' sentence ke start mein hai? Toh options mein us option ko choose karo jo kisi question ki tarah Helping Verb (has/have/did) se shuru ho raha ho.
tip: Negative words se vakya shuru hone par hamesha Inversion (HV + Subject) apply karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: To curb the rampant inflation, the monetary policy committee must aggressively hike interest rates, absorb excess liquidity, and ____________.
options: to maintain a hawkish stance on future rate cuts
maintaining a hawkish stance on future rate cuts
maintain a hawkish stance on future rate cuts
the maintenance of a hawkish stance on future rate cuts
answer: maintain a hawkish stance on future rate cuts
explanation: Parallelism in Modal Verb Lists: Sentence mein 'must' (modal verb) ke baad V1 verbs ki ek series ban rahi hai: (must) 'hike', (must) 'absorb'. Isliye 'and' ke baad aane wala teesra action bhi strictly base form (V1) mein hoga. 'To maintain' ya 'maintaining' symmetry ko tod denge. Rampant matlab 'tez/aniyantrit' aur hawkish matlab 'sakht/kathor'.
trick: List padho: hike (V1), absorb (V1), toh 'and' ke baad waala verb bhi sirf V1 (maintain) hi hoga.
tip: Modal verbs ke baad chalne wali series mein 'to' ya 'ing' nahi lagate, sirf V1 use hota hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: A critical analysis of the current fiscal quarter reveals that neither the export incentives nor the slashed corporate tax rate ____________.
options: have succeeded in reviving the stagnant private investment
has succeeded in reviving the stagnant private investment
are succeeding in reviving the stagnant private investment
succeed in reviving the stagnant private investment
answer: has succeeded in reviving the stagnant private investment
explanation: Proximity Rule of Subject-Verb Agreement: Jab do subjects 'neither... nor' se judte hain, toh verb humesha 'nor' ke theek baad wale subject ke anusaar lagta hai. Yahan 'nor' ke baad 'corporate tax rate' hai jo ki Singular (ekvachan) hai. Isliye singular verb 'has' aayega, na ki plural 'have'. Slashed matlab 'ghata hua' aur stagnant matlab 'ruka hua/sthir'.
trick: Neither-Nor mein bas 'Nor' ke baad wale shabd par focus karo ('rate'). Ye singular hai, toh verb (has) bhi singular aayegi.
tip: Neither...nor aur Either...or mein verb hamesha nearest subject ke hisaab se lagti hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Unless the municipal authorities expeditiously address the severely dilapidated drainage infrastructure, ____________.
options: the low-lying areas will not be submerged during the monsoons
the low-lying areas would be submerged during the monsoons
the low-lying areas will be submerged during the monsoons
the low-lying areas will not succumb to submersion
answer: the low-lying areas will be submerged during the monsoons
explanation: Conditionals with 'Unless': 'Unless' ka matlab 'If not' (jab tak nahi) hota hai. Ye First Conditional ka structure hai. Unless clause Simple Present ('address') mein hai, toh main clause Future Tense ('will be') mein hoga. Context dekhein: Agar drainage theek nahi hua, toh areas doobenge (positive outcome). 'will not be submerged' logic ke khilaf hai. Dilapidated matlab 'toota-phoota/jajar' aur expeditiously matlab 'tezi se'.
trick: Unless wale phrase ka hindi anuvad socho: 'Jab tak theek nahi karenge...' Toh uska asar bura hi hoga, yaani area doob jayega. Isliye 'will be submerged' sahi hai.
tip: Unless negative hai, iske result clause mein logic ka dhyan se prayog karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The primary reason for the abrupt withdrawal of foreign portfolio investments from the domestic equity market is ____________.
options: because the global central banks are adopting a hawkish monetary policy
due to the global central banks adopting a hawkish monetary policy
that the global central banks are adopting a hawkish monetary policy
how the global central banks are adopting a hawkish monetary policy
answer: that the global central banks are adopting a hawkish monetary policy
explanation: Noun Clause Rule ('The reason... is that'): Grammatically, 'The reason is...' ke baad hum karan (reason) batane ke liye hamesha 'that' se shuru hone wala Noun Clause lagate hain. 'Because' ya 'due to' lagana redundancy (faltu dohrav) kahlata hai kyunki 'reason' word mein pehle se hi 'karan' chupa hai. Abrupt matlab 'achanak'.
trick: Jab sentence ki shuruat 'The reason... is' se ho, toh option mein aankh band karke 'that' wala option mark karo. 'Because' humesha galat hoga.
tip: 'The reason is' hamesha 'that' se follow hota hai, 'because' ya 'due to' se nahi.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: No sooner did the finance minister announce the contentious retrospective taxation amendments ____________.
options: when the benchmark stock indices crashed significantly
then the benchmark stock indices crashed significantly
than the benchmark stock indices crashed significantly
that the benchmark stock indices crashed significantly
answer: than the benchmark stock indices crashed significantly
explanation: Correlative Pair 'No sooner... than': 'No sooner' ek comparative phrase hai jiska matlab hai 'jaise hi... waise hi'. Comparative (sooner) hone ki wajah se iske sath hamesha comparative conjunction 'than' (T-H-A-N) lagta hai, 'when', 'then', ya 'that' nahi. Contentious matlab 'vivadaspad' aur retrospective matlab 'pichli tarikh se laagoo hone wala'.
trick: 'No sooner' word ke 'er' (comparative) par dhyan do. Comparatives apne sath humesha T-H-A-N (than) lete hain.
tip: 'No sooner' ka proper pair hamesha 'than' hota hai, iske alawa kuch bhi galat hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Having operated in a hyper-globalized environment for over two decades, multinational supply chains are not accustomed ____________.
options: to deal with such stringent protectionist trade barriers
to dealing with such stringent protectionist trade barriers
for dealing with such stringent protectionist trade barriers
in dealing with such stringent protectionist trade barriers
answer: to dealing with such stringent protectionist trade barriers
explanation: Prepositional Idiom (Accustomed to): 'Accustomed to' (aadi hona) ek fixed English idiom hai. Yahan 'to' ek preposition hai, infinitive marker (to + V1) nahi. Preposition ke baad humesha verb ki 'ing' form (gerund) ka prayog hota hai. Isliye 'to dealing' sahi hai, 'to deal' galat. Protectionist matlab 'sanrakshanvadi' aur stringent matlab 'kathor'.
trick: English mein 'look forward to', 'prone to' aur 'accustomed to' ke baad 'to' ke theek aage gerund (verb + ing) aata hai.
tip: 'Accustomed to' phrase ke theek baad hamesha V1+ing (gerund) form ka prayog karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Each of the regional rural banks and microfinance institutions must ensure that ____________.
options: their credit disbursement policies are aligned with rural needs
its credit disbursement policies are aligned with rural needs
there credit disbursement policies are aligned with rural needs
it's credit disbursement policies are aligned with rural needs
answer: its credit disbursement policies are aligned with rural needs
explanation: Pronoun Antecedent Agreement ('Each of'): Jab sentence 'Each of' ya 'Every' se shuru hota hai, toh subject ko mathematically singular (ekvachan) maana jata hai, chahe baad mein plural nouns (banks and institutions) hi kyun na hon. Isliye unke liye lagne wala pronoun bhi singular 'its' hoga, 'their' nahi. Disbursement matlab 'vitran/baantna'.
trick: Sentence ki shuruaat mein 'Each' ya 'Every' dikh jaye, toh options mein sidha singular possessive pronoun (its/his/her) dhoond kar click karo.
tip: 'Each of' wale subjects humesha singular pronoun (its) lete hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Scarcely had the bilateral ceasefire agreement been ratified by the conflicting nations ____________.
options: than isolated skirmishes erupted across the contested border
when isolated skirmishes erupted across the contested border
then isolated skirmishes erupted across the contested border
before isolated skirmishes erupt across the contested border
answer: when isolated skirmishes erupted across the contested border
explanation: Conjunction Pairing (Scarcely... when): 'Scarcely' aur 'Hardly' negative adverbs hain jinke baad hamesha conjunction 'when' (ya kabhi kabhi 'before') ka use hota hai, 'than' ya 'then' ka nahi. 'Than' sirf 'No sooner' ke sath lagta hai. Action past mein chal raha hai isliye 'erupt' (V1) galat hai. Skirmishes matlab 'chhoti jhadap' aur ratified matlab 'adhikarik roop se manzoor'.
trick: Hardly/Scarcely ka direct connection 'when' se hai. 'Than' aur 'Then' dekhte hi kaat do.
tip: Scarcely aur Hardly hamesha 'when' ke sath use hote hain, 'than' ke sath nahi.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Had the regulatory body stringently audited the shadow banking sector earlier, ____________.
options: the catastrophic financial contagion would not spread
the catastrophic financial contagion would not have spread
the catastrophic financial contagion had not spread
the catastrophic financial contagion will not have spread
answer: the catastrophic financial contagion would not have spread
explanation: Third Conditional (Unfulfilled Past): Sentence 'Had + Subject + V3' (Had the body audited) se start ho raha hai, jo past ki ek unreal (jo nahi hui) condition ko batata hai. Aise sentences ke main/result clause mein hamesha 'would have + V3' lagaya jata hai. Stringently matlab 'kathorai se' aur contagion matlab 'ek se doosre mein phailne wali beemari/mandi'.
trick: Sentence ki shuruaat 'Had + V3' se hui hai? Toh seedha options mein jao aur 'would have + V3' wala combination dhoond kar us par nishana lagao.
tip: Past ki unfulfilled condition hamesha 'would have + V3' structure leti hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The more the sovereign debt of a developing nation balloons beyond sustainable limits, ____________.
options: the higher the probability of a sovereign default becomes
the more higher the probability of a sovereign default becomes
higher is the probability of a sovereign default becoming
the highest the probability of a sovereign default becomes
answer: the higher the probability of a sovereign default becomes
explanation: Double Comparatives (Proportionate Change): Jab do cheezein ek sath badhti ya ghatti hain, toh dono hisso mein 'The + Comparative Degree' ka prayog hota hai. Pehle part mein 'The more' hai, isliye dusre part mein 'the higher' aayega. 'more higher' ek sath likhna double comparative error hai. Balloons matlab 'gubaare ki tarah phoolna/badhna' aur default matlab 'karz chukaane mein nakamyabi'.
trick: Formula match karo: 'The + Comparative ... , The + Comparative ...'. Options mein dhoondo kiski shuruat saaf suthre 'The + er/more' se hui hai.
tip: Samaan roop se badhne/ghatne ko dikhane ke liye 'The + comparative' ka formula best hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: Although the newly implemented labor codes are intended to formalize the unorganized sector, ____________.
options: but trade unions fear they will lead to widespread job insecurity
yet trade unions fear they will lead to widespread job insecurity
trade unions fear they will lead to widespread job insecurity
despite trade unions fearing they will lead to widespread job insecurity
answer: trade unions fear they will lead to widespread job insecurity
explanation: Conjunction Redundancy: Standard English Grammar kehte hai ki jab koi sentence 'Although' ya 'Though' (halaanki) se shuru hota hai, toh uske doosre clause ko jodne ke liye 'but' ya 'yet' lagana bilkul zaruri nahi hai. Ek comma (,) hi poora kaam kar deta hai. 'But' ka prayog superflous error maana jata hai. Unorganized sector matlab 'asangathit kshetra'.
trick: Sentence ka pehla shabd 'Although' hai, isliye comma ke baad wale option mein 'but' ya 'yet' dekh kar usko eliminate kar do.
tip: 'Although' wale vakya mein main clause ke aage 'but' ka prayog grammatically galat hai.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The search committee has finally shortlisted a dynamic executive, one ____________.
options: whom they believe can steer the organization out of bankruptcy
who they believe can steer the organization out of bankruptcy
which they believe can steer the organization out of bankruptcy
whom can be believed to steer the organization out of bankruptcy
answer: who they believe can steer the organization out of bankruptcy
explanation: Relative Pronoun (Who vs Whom) in Embedded Clauses: Yahan 'they believe' ek extra (parenthetical) clause hai. Exam mein aisi confusion aane par 'they believe' ko man mein hata do. Ab sentence padho: '...one ___ can steer'. Yahan 'can steer' verb ko apna subject chahiye, jo ki 'who' hota hai ('whom' object hota hai). Steer matlab 'chalana/raasta dikhana' aur bankruptcy matlab 'diwaliyapan'.
trick: 'they believe' ya 'I think' ko ignore karke padho. Agar relative pronoun ke theek baad verb (can steer) bachta hai, toh hamesha 'who' aayega.
tip: Verb ko hamesha subject ki zaroorat hoti hai, isliye 'who' ka prayog karein.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The indigenous aerospace startup managed to secure the lucrative defense contract, despite ____________.
options: of the fact that it lacked prior manufacturing experience
the fact that it lacked prior manufacturing experience
that it lacked prior manufacturing experience
it lacking prior manufacturing experience
answer: the fact that it lacked prior manufacturing experience
explanation: Preposition vs Clause: 'Despite' (ke bawajood) ek preposition hai, iske baad directly poora sentence/clause (Subject + Verb) nahi aa sakta. Option 3 galat hai. 'Despite of' grammar mein exist nahi karta ('in spite of' hota hai). Isliye clause jodne ke liye hum 'the fact that' ka bridge banate hain. Indigenous matlab 'swadeshi' aur lucrative matlab 'faydemand'.
trick: Despite ke sath 'of' kabhi nahi lagta. Aur despite ke baad lamba sentence dalna ho toh 'the fact that' laga kar hi joda jata hai.
tip: 'Despite' ke baad poora vakya likhne ke liye 'the fact that' ka use karte hain.

question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to complete the sentence so that it becomes grammatically correct and contextually meaningful. || Question: The commercial real estate sector has remained significantly depressed ever since the central bank ____________.
options: has aggressively increased the benchmark lending rates
had aggressively increased the benchmark lending rates
aggressively increased the benchmark lending rates
is aggressively increasing the benchmark lending rates
answer: aggressively increased the benchmark lending rates
explanation: Tense Rules for 'Since': Jab 'ever since' point of time (jab se) ko dikhata hai, toh uska ek fix rule hota hai: Main Clause Present Perfect ('has remained') mein hota hai, aur Since-Clause hamesha Simple Past (V2) mein hota hai. Isliye 'increased' (V2) aayega, 'has increased' ya 'had increased' galat hai. Depressed matlab 'mandi ka shikar'.
trick: 'Ever since' ke theek baad wale hisse mein humesha Verb ki 2nd form (Simple Past) lagao.
tip: 'Since' time reference clause hamesha Simple Past tense (V2) follow karta hai.
